thesis.inflection_thesis: Rising demand for gallium arsenide and indium phosphide substrates used in photonics and RF components could benefit from AI-driven optical component demand.
thesis.confirmation_conditions: Two consecutive quarters of substrate segment bookings growth and a return to positive gross margin without one-time benefits.
thesis.invalidation_conditions: Continued revenue decline, sustained operating losses, further guidance cuts, or additional export-license disruption affecting a material portion of shipments.
thesis.key_risks: Meaningful revenue exposure tied to export licensing conditions; customer concentration; sustained operating losses raising balance-sheet questions; competitive substrate pricing pressure.
